headline: Ideology Follows Oppression · Fields 1990
quote: People are more readily perceived as inferior by nature when they are already seen as oppressed.
attribution: Barbara J. Fields, 'Slavery, Race and Ideology in the United States of America,' New Left Review 181 (1990), p. 106
sources: Fields (1990), New Left Review 181, 95–118; The Original Power, Ch. 2, §2.2
